evals.prompt: Research how a Life-Boat-style support bot should respond to a user caught in a repetitive self-critical thought loop. Use high-quality evidence, distinguish reflection from forced questioning, and turn findings into regression tests without using private user text.
evals.expected_output: A tiered evidence report with uncertainty, behavior implications, baseline checks, and testable regressions.

evals.prompt: Review a proposed change to the Life-Boat bot that adds a question to every reply and sends progress messages while reading skills. Decide whether it is an improvement, using evidence and the accepted baseline.
evals.expected_output: Reject the change as a likely regression unless evidence and replay show a clear user-facing improvement; include rollback and cost checks.

evals.prompt: Design a research plan for making Life-Boat adaptive over months while respecting consent, memory privacy, crisis safety, Hebrew/RTL context, and a strict no-paid-work default.
evals.expected_output: A staged plan with source-quality tiers, cross-validation, aggregate evaluation, and explicit proof gaps.
